lines.1: 「Oho? Oh my, oh my, oh my?」
lines.2: That wicked smile tells me everything.
lines.4: And I got completely carried away.
lines.5: 「Nagomin, didn't you just say something very passionate? Hm?」
lines.7: 「I don't rise to childish taunts! I'm alwaaays perfectly caaalm!」
lines.10: 「Hmph. How ridiculous. Besides, I didn't say anything just now. I was only working.」
lines.11: Oh, Nagomi plans to play dumb all the way through.
lines.12: 「What do you mean, you said nothing? I heard you perfectly.」
lines.13: 「You were hearing things. Weren't you, Senpai?」
lines.16: 「Too soft. Softer than one of those ten-yen yogurt candies, Nagomin.」
lines.17: 「Yoppi, what do you have for us?」
lines.18: Yoppi?! There should be only three of us here...
lines.20: And then Yoppi emerges from a locker!
lines.22: 「I got perfect footage of what happened earlier.」
lines.28: 「So much for being calm. You two are all lovey-dovey, and you're practically bursting with jealousy.」
lines.32: 「Making a fuss because another girl touched your boyfriend a little? That's pretty cringeworthy.」
lines.33: 「Are you the type who says you were together in a past life and will be together after you're reborn too?」
lines.34: 「That's a little mean. She is only a first-year.」
lines.35: 「Oh, right. She's still a child. Children are so possessive.」
lines.36: 「H-hmph... The Princess and her friends certainly have time to waste...」
lines.37: Oh, Yashi still intends to fight back!
lines.39: 「Oh, Yoppi, be careful not to pat Tsushima on the shoulder. She might yell at you.」
lines.40: 「Senpaaai... My very own Senpaaai! Don't you touch him so caaasually!」
lines.47: 「Victory!」 The smile of someone who has accomplished her mission.
lines.48: 「That's what you get for pretending to be so cool. It would've been even funnier if you'd cried.」
lines.50: 「You should be thanking me. Even if it was an act, I fed you chocolate myself.」
lines.51: For some reason, the Princess proudly puffs out her chest.
lines.52: 「I can't believe you joined in on bullying her, Sato...」
lines.53: 「In the end, I'll always take Ellie's side. Sorry...」
lines.57: Getting her back into a good mood is going to be rough.
